claim_one_line: L140 EXECUTED -- THE FIRST GATE AIMED AT CLAIM SCOPE. The rule: a LAW_MAP row citing an arc whose VERDICT carries >= 4 scope markers must carry at least one scope marker of its own (markers: only-for, scope, assumes, not-established, conditional, up-to, one-prime, not-certified, not-claimed, post-hoc, inferred, cited-not-re-derived, screened, necessary-not-sufficient, limits, does-not, NB). Registered BOTH directions per the practices rule: gate 'lawmap-scope' in scripts/gates/gates.py and a row in docs/PRACTICES.md. WHY THIS RULE AND NOT ANOTHER: B965's audit found that in EVERY fix the arc's own verdict was CORRECT and PROPERLY SCOPED -- nothing was wrong with the mathematics or with the arcs -- and THE QUALIFIER DIED IN THE COMPRESSION STEP, turning a verdict into a one-line row; so the gate is placed exactly there and nowhere else. This is the FIRST GATE IN THIS REPO AIMED AT CLAIM SCOPE rather than at numbers, hashes, paths or file presence, i.e. at the class of error that until today only a human ever caught. CALIBRATION: against B965's audit the gate flags ALL THREE rows that audit had to fix and PASSES the row that audit adjudicated as already correctly scoped (the no-centralizer row, which carries 'SCOPE NOW UNCONDITIONAL (B960)' and names '(Steinberg)'). AND ON ITS VERY FIRST CALIBRATION RUN IT FOUND A FOURTH VIOLATION THE AUDIT HAD MISSED: the F4 row cites B962 -- which B964 PARTIALLY RETRACTED -- without saying so; now fixed, with the row recording that B962 was partly retracted, that this finding is among those that survive, and that the orbit stratification is cited rather than re-derived here. NON-VACUITY DEMONSTRATED, NOT ASSUMED (per MB12, a gate that cannot fail is not a gate): deleting the qualifier 'INFERRED from the rank bookkeeping, NOT computed' from the two-seeds row makes the gate FAIL, restoring it makes the gate PASS, and the file was restored byte-identical. LIMITS: it is KEYWORD-BASED and cannot see a scope loss phrased without any marker, while a row can satisfy it with a marker that is present but irrelevant -- it raises the floor, it does not certify a row; it covers LAW_MAP ONLY, while CAMPAIGN_STATUS, README and PROGRESS_LOG headlines carry compressed claims and are NOT covered (extending it there is the obvious next step); the threshold of 4 is calibrated on ONE audit of 165 rows and is a defensible choice, not a derived constant; and it enforces the PRESENCE of a qualifier, NOT its correctness, so a human still has to read. L140 executed; L139 (retraction sweeps) remains OPEN and still has no machinery.
